why: Strip color tags now top level in context and Strip menus.

why: Set Start/End Frame removed from Sequencer Navigation > Range; new footer icons.
draft copy: Set Start Frame and Set End Frame are now only the buttons next to Start and End in the footer.

title: Weight paint Mode - Expose Select Loop Pick for discoverability and consistency #6426
why: Select Loop Pick now exposed in Weight and Vertex Paint selection masking.
draft copy: With selection masking on, use Select Loop to pick a whole edge loop in Weight Paint and Vertex Paint.

title: Week 40 - Compositor - Migrate new Bloom asset
why: New Bloom essentials asset; only Glare Bloom type is documented.
draft copy: Bloom adds a soft glow around bright parts of the image. Find it in the Essentials assets; you can also use it as a scene effect.
screenshot to take: Compositor > Add > Assets (Essentials) with Bloom

title: Compositor - new Matrix nodes (same as Geometry Nodes)
why: Compositor now has Matrix nodes; utilities page has no Matrix group.
draft copy: Utilities > Matrix holds the same matrix nodes as Geometry Nodes, such as Combine Transform and Separate Transform. Use them to build or split transforms for image placement.
screenshot to take: Compositor > Add > Utilities > Matrix submenu open

title: Compositor - New String nodes (same as Geometry Nodes)
why: Compositor now has String/Text nodes; no Text group in compositor docs.
draft copy: Utilities > Text holds string nodes like Join Strings, Format String and Value to String, the same as in Geometry Nodes. Combine them with String to Image to put text on your render.
screenshot to take: Compositor > Add > Utilities > Text submenu open

title: Compositor - Object Info has rotation socket now
why: Compositor Object Info node (now with Rotation socket) isn't documented at all.
draft copy: Object Info gives you the location, rotation and scale of a chosen object, so you can drive compositing effects from where things are in your scene.
screenshot to take: Compositor > Add > Input > Scene > Object Info node with outputs visible

title: Compositor - Utilities - New Rotation group of nodes #6534
why: Compositor gets the Rotation node group from Geometry Nodes; missing.
draft copy: Utilities > Rotation holds the rotation nodes from Geometry Nodes, such as Euler to Rotation and Rotate Rotation, for working with rotation values in the compositor.
screenshot to take: Compositor > Add > Utilities > Rotation submenu open

title: Feat: Compositor > Toolshelf > Utilities - Add new Utilities and Math nodes #6716
why: Random Value, Hash Value, Integer/Bit Math nodes now in compositor; utilities page lacks them.
draft copy: Random Value outputs a random number, vector or color per call; use its seed to get different results. The Math group also has Integer Math and Bit Math for whole numbers.
screenshot to take: Compositor > Add > Utilities and Utilities > Math menus open

title: Feat: Compositor > Toolshelf > Input > Scene - Add Is Viewport node #6740
why: Is Viewport node in compositor not documented on compositor Input page.
draft copy: Is Viewport outputs True while the compositor runs in the viewport and False in the final render, so you can use lighter settings while you work.
screenshot to take: Compositor > Add > Input > Scene menu with Is Viewport

title: Sequencer + Compositor - New Sequencer mode with Sequencer Info strip #5806
why: Sequencer-mode Strip Info node (new SEQUENCE icon) isn't documented; compositor input page lacks it.
draft copy: Sequencer Strip Info gives you data about the strip the compositor is running on, so you can drive effects per strip. It only shows in the compositor's Sequencer mode.
screenshot to take: Compositor (Sequencer mode) > Add > Input menu with Sequencer Strip Info highlighted

title: Compositor - Add - Input - Scene - New Active Camera and Camera Info node
why: Active Camera and Camera Info now in Compositor Input > Scene; not listed.
draft copy: Active Camera outputs the scene's active camera as an object. Camera Info reads that camera's data, such as focal length and sensor size, so you can use it in the compositor.
screenshot to take: Compositor > Add > Input > Scene submenu

title: Compositor - Add - Utilities - New Matrix nodes
why: Compositor now has Utilities > Matrix nodes; page has Math and Vector only.
draft copy: The Matrix submenu holds the same matrix nodes as Geometry Nodes, such as Combine Matrix, Invert Matrix and Transform Point. Use them to build or apply transforms in the compositor.
screenshot to take: Compositor > Add > Utilities > Matrix submenu

title: Compositor - Filter - new Mask to SDF Node #6151
why: New Mask to SDF node not on Filter page.
draft copy: Mask to SDF turns a mask into a distance field: each pixel gets its distance to the mask edge. Use it for outlines, glows and soft falloffs.
screenshot to take: Compositor > Add > Filter with Mask to SDF; node result on viewer

title: Compositor - Output node - Tooltip on dynamic paths
why: File Output paths now support dynamic path variables with tooltip; not explained.
draft copy: Output paths can use variables in curly braces, such as {blend_name} or {frame}. Bforartists fills them in when it saves. Hover the path field to see which ones you can use.
screenshot to take: Compositor > File Output node with path tooltip showing variables

title: Compositor - Overlays - Passpertout Region background
why: New passepartout/region background overlay option not in compositor overlay docs.
draft copy: Passepartout darkens the area outside the render region in the compositor backdrop, so you can focus on what will be in the final image.
screenshot to take: Compositor > Header > Overlays popover with Passepartout setting

title: Compositor - Sidebar - Option - Make Cache Frames better with indents #6661
why: Options tab Cache Frames settings undocumented; author asked for docs.
draft copy: Cache Frames keeps already computed frames in memory so scrubbing replays them quickly. Its sub-settings are indented below and only matter when it's on.
screenshot to take: Compositor > Sidebar > Options tab with Cache Frames expanded

title: Geometry Nodes - New Rename Attribute node #6482
why: New Rename Attribute node; attribute page lacks it.
draft copy: Rename Attribute gives an existing attribute a new name without changing its data. Type the old name and the new name, and the geometry passes through with the renamed attribute.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add > Attribute menu with Rename Attribute node added

title: Geometry Nodes - Utilities - Sound - New Sample Sound Frequency node #6520
why: New Utilities > Sound category with Sample Sound Frequency node; not documented.
draft copy: Sample Sound Frequency reads the loudness of a sound at a frequency range for the current frame. Use it to make geometry move to music.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add > Utilities > Sound submenu open

title: Geometry Nodes - New List Nodes (x5) #6538
why: Five new nodes: Lists group, Collection Children, Split String; none documented.
draft copy: Utilities > Lists holds nodes that work with lists of values: Field to List collects a field into a list, Get List Item picks one entry, and List Length counts them. Collection Children (Input > Scene) lists a collection's child collections, and Split String (Utilities > Text) cuts text into a list at a separator.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add > Utilities > Lists submenu open

title: Geometry Nodes - New Cluster nodes and Merge Points node
why: New Cluster by Distance, Cluster by Connected and Merge Points nodes; none documented.
draft copy: Merge Points merges points that sit close together into one. Cluster by Distance and Cluster by Connected give each element a cluster ID, grouped by distance or by mesh connectivity.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add > Geometry > Operations with Merge Points

title: Geometry Nodes - Utilities - Lists - New Filter List node #6577
why: New Filter List node in Utilities > Lists; add with #1213.
draft copy: Filter List keeps only the list items where the selection is true and drops the rest.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add > Utilities > Lists with Filter List

title: Geometry Nodes - Geometry- Operations- New Get Geometry Component node #6578
why: New Get Geometry Component node in Operations; not documented.
draft copy: Get Geometry Component pulls out one component, like the mesh or the instances, from a geometry so you can work on it alone.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add > Geometry > Operations with Get Geometry Component

title: Geometry Nodes - Volume - Operrations - Deactivate Voxels node #6662
why: New Deactivate Voxels node not in Volume > Operations.
draft copy: Deactivate Voxels turns selected voxels of a grid inactive, so they go back to the background value and stop using memory.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add > Volume > Operations > Deactivate Voxels node

title: Geometry Nodes - Curves - Read - NURBS Order and Weight nodes #6664
why: New NURBS Order and NURBS Weight read nodes missing from Curve > Read.
draft copy: NURBS Order outputs the order of each NURBS spline. NURBS Weight outputs the weight of each control point.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add > Curve > Read with NURBS Order and Weight nodes

title: Geometry Nodes - Grease Pencil - Read - New nodes #6654
why: New Grease Pencil Read nodes; Read only lists Named Layer Selection. Set Color icon updated.
draft copy: The Grease Pencil Read category has nodes that output layer and stroke data, so you can use them as fields in your node tree.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add > Grease Pencil > Read menu open

title: Geometry Nodes - Mesh - Operation - New Mesh Bevel Node #6644
why: New Mesh Bevel node missing from Mesh > Operations.
draft copy: Mesh Bevel rounds the selected edges or vertices of a mesh, like the Bevel modifier but inside a node tree.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add > Mesh > Operations > Mesh Bevel node with inputs

title: Geometry Nodes - Volume - Utility - Grid Topology Boolean #6663
why: New Grid Topology Boolean node; author asks for docs.
draft copy: Grid Topology Boolean combines which voxels are active in two grids (union, intersect or difference) without changing the values.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add > Volume > Grid Topology Boolean node

title: Icon: Geometry Nodes > Volume > Read - New Get Grid Names node needs icon and toolshelf entry #6866
why: New Get Grid Names node not on Volume > Read.
draft copy: Get Grid Names lists the names of all grids stored in a volume, in alphabetical order.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add > Volume > Read menu with Get Grid Names

title: Icon: Geometry Nodes > Curve - New Construct Curves node needs icon and toolshelf entry #6865
why: New Construct Curves node undocumented.
draft copy: Construct Curves builds curves from point positions and curve offsets, like Construct Mesh does for meshes.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add > Curve menu with Construct Curves

title: Icon: Geometry Nodes > Geometry > Material - New Geometry Materials node needs icon and toolshelf entry #6717
why: New Geometry Materials node missing from Material section.
draft copy: Geometry Materials outputs the list of materials used by a geometry, from any component that has materials.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add > Geometry > Material menu

title: Icon: Geometry Nodes > Utilities > Lists - New Combine List node needs icon and toolshelf entry #6808
why: Utilities > List group (Combine List, Field to List) has no section.
draft copy: Combine List joins its inputs into one list.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add > Utilities > List menu open

title: Icon: Geometry Nodes > Simulation - New XPBD Solver node needs icon and toolshelf entry #6807
why: New XPBD Solver node undocumented.
draft copy: XPBD Solver runs a position-based dynamics simulation on geometry that matches its tag filter. Use it inside a Simulation Zone.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add > Simulation menu with XPBD Solver

title: Icon: Geometry Nodes > Sidebar > Add > Point - Add icons to Rasterize Points and Set Point Cloud Type #6899
why: Rasterize Points and Set Point Cloud Type undocumented.
draft copy: Rasterize Points turns points into a grid. Set Point Cloud Type changes how a point cloud is stored and drawn.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add > Point menu

title: Icon: Geometry Nodes > Sidebar > Input > Import - Add icon and add SPZ to sidebar #6900
why: Import SPZ node missing from Input > Import.
draft copy: Import SPZ (.spz) loads a Gaussian splat file as a point cloud.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add > Input > Import menu with Import SPZ

title: Icon: Geometry Nodes > Sidebar > Add > Attribute - Add icons Get Attribute Names and Transfer Attributes #6901
why: Get Attribute Names and Transfer Attributes absent from Attribute page.
draft copy: Get Attribute Names lists the names of the attributes on a geometry. Transfer Attributes copies attributes from one geometry to another.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add > Attribute menu

title: Icon: Geometry Nodes > Sidebar > Volume > Sample - Add icons to Grid Solve Poisson and add to sidebar #6902
why: Grid Solve Poisson missing from Volume > Sample.
draft copy: Grid Solve Poisson solves a Poisson equation on a grid, for example to smooth values or fill a field from its sources.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add > Volume > Sample menu

title: Icon: Geometry Nodes > Sidebar > Utilities > Vector - Add icon to Vector Component #6904
why: Get Vector Component node undocumented in Vector section.
draft copy: Get Vector Component outputs one component (X, Y or Z) of a vector.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add > Utilities > Vector menu

title: Icon: Geometry Nodes > Sidebar > Utilities > Text - Add icons to Reverse String, Set String Case and Tag Filter #6905
why: Reverse String, Set String Case, Tag Filter missing from Text section.
draft copy: Reverse String flips the order of characters. Set String Case changes text to upper or lower case. Tag Filter checks a string against a list of tags.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add > Utilities > Text menu

title: Icon: Geometry Nodes > Sidebar > Utilities > Bundle - Add icons to Get Nested Bundle Paths and Typed Bundle #6903
why: Get Nested Bundle Paths and Typed Bundle missing from Bundle section.
draft copy: Get Nested Bundle Paths lists the paths inside a bundle, including nested ones. Typed Bundle adds a Combine Bundle node set to a chosen bundle type.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add > Utilities > Bundle menu

title: Geometry Nodes - Add NURBS Order and Weight nodes #6322
why: New NURBS Order and Weight nodes absent from curve page.
draft copy: These nodes read and set the order and the control-point weights of NURBS splines. A higher weight pulls the curve closer to that point.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add > Curve menu with NURBS nodes

title: Geometry Nodes - Add the Matrix SVD node #6428
why: Matrix SVD node missing from Utilities > Matrix list.
draft copy: Matrix SVD splits a matrix into three parts: two rotations and a scale in between. Use it to pull a clean rotation and scale out of any transform matrix.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add > Utilities > Matrix with Matrix SVD

title: Geometry Nodes - Add Icon for Cube Grid Topology node #6250
why: Cube Grid Topology node undocumented; PR asks explicitly for docs.
draft copy: Cube Grid Topology creates an empty grid with a box of active voxels. Use it as a starting topology for volume grid nodes like Field to Grid.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add > Volume menu with Cube Grid Topology; node in editor

title: Geometry Nodes - New Bundle Nodes #6237
why: Get Bundle Item and Store Bundle Item missing from Bundle section.
draft copy: Get Bundle Item reads one item from a bundle by name. Store Bundle Item adds or replaces one item, so you don't have to separate and combine the whole bundle.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add > Utilities > Bundle submenu

title: Geometry Nodes - Utilities - Text - New Trim String node #6366
why: Trim String not in Utilities > Text list.
draft copy: Trim String removes spaces and other whitespace from the start, the end, or both ends of a string.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add > Utilities > Text submenu

title: Node Editors - New Implicit Conversion Node #6307
why: New Implicit Conversion node not in any node editor docs.
draft copy: Implicit Conversion converts a value to another socket type the same way a direct link would. It makes the conversion visible and lets you choose where it happens.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add menu showing Implicit Conversion; tool shelf entry

title: Node Editors - Made the Constant sidebar entries in the node editor consistent #6323
why: Menu constant (all editors) and Integer Vector (compositor) missing from Input > Constant pages.
draft copy: Menu outputs a menu choice you can wire into Menu Switch nodes or group inputs. Integer Vector outputs a vector of whole numbers.
screenshot to take: Compositor > Add > Input > Constant; same for Geometry Nodes and Shader

title: Node Editors - Group Sockets - Structure - Add icons to Structure dropdown #5257 #5858
why: Socket Structure Type dropdown is not documented on any node sidebar page; icons now added.
draft copy: Structure Type sets what kind of data a group socket accepts: Auto, Single value, Field, Grid, List and so on. The icons in the dropdown show each kind at a glance.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Sidebar > Group tab > socket selected > Structure Type dropdown open

title: Icon: Geometry Nodes > Sidebar > Relations > Layout - Add Comment to sidebar and add icon #6897
why: New Comment node not on Layout page (shared by all node editors).
draft copy: Comment adds a note to your node tree. You can format the text with Markdown.
screenshot to take: Geometry Nodes > Add > Layout menu with Comment, plus a Comment node in the tree

title: Shader Editor - New Input constant nodes now consistent with other editors
why: Shader Input now has a Constant submenu like other editors; page still lists Color/Value top-level.
draft copy: The Constant submenu holds nodes that output a single fixed value: Boolean, Color, Integer, Menu, Value and Vector. They work the same way in all node editors.
screenshot to take: Shader Editor > Add > Input > Constant submenu open

title: Shader - New Scene Time node
why: New Scene Time node in Shader Editor; not in Input page.
draft copy: Scene Time gives you the current frame and the time in seconds, so you can animate shader values without keyframes.
screenshot to take: Shader Editor > Add > Input > Scene Time node

title: Feat: Shader Editor > Toolshelf > Utilities - Add Index Switch and Switch nodes #6739
why: Shader Index Switch and Switch nodes missing; only Menu Switch documented.
draft copy: Switch picks one of two inputs with a True/False toggle. Index Switch picks one of several inputs by number.
screenshot to take: Shader Editor > Add > Utilities menu with Index Switch, Menu Switch and Switch

title: Icon: Shader Editor > Input and Shader - New Light nodes need icons and toolshelf entries #6806
why: Four EEVEE light nodes undocumented (Input and Shader).
draft copy: Light Evaluation, Light Info and Shadow Raycast (Input) and Light Accumulation (Shader) work only with EEVEE in object shaders. They let you build your own lighting response.
screenshot to take: Shader Editor (EEVEE) > Add > Input menu, and Add > Shader menu

title: Merge - Week 35
why: Merge added 6 shader (light) nodes and 2 geometry nodes; need add-menu entries.
draft copy: Several light nodes are new in the Shader Editor's Add menu. Each one reads information about lights while rendering.
screenshot to take: Shader Editor and Geometry Nodes Add menus showing the new nodes

title: Icon: 3D View > Armature > Pose Mode > Animation - Convert Rotation Mode needs icon #6712
why: Convert Rotation Mode operator not documented in Animation submenu.
draft copy: Convert Rotation Mode converts existing rotation keys to another rotation mode, so the motion stays the same. Shortcut in Pose Mode: Ctrl R.
screenshot to take: Pose Mode > Pose > Animation submenu with Convert Rotation Mode

title: Icon: 3D View > GreasePencil > Edit Mode - New Deselect Linked operator #6679
why: New Deselect Linked operator in GP Edit Select menu; GP section lists no Linked entries.
draft copy: Deselect Linked deselects all points connected to the points under or in your selection, the opposite of Select Linked.
screenshot to take: 3D View > Grease Pencil Edit Mode > Select menu open, showing Select Linked / Deselect Linked

title: Feat: 3D View > Grease Pencil > Edit Mode > Sidebar - Add more point operators #6171
why: Toolshelf Point tab gains Add New Vertex Group and Corner Round/Flat/Sharp; not documented.
draft copy: The Point tab in the tool shelf also has Add New Vertex Group and three corner buttons: Corner Round, Corner Flat and Corner Sharp, which set the corner type of the selected points.
screenshot to take: Grease Pencil Edit Mode > Tool shelf Point tab, text view showing all six buttons

title: Feat: 3D View > Mesh > Edit Mode > Transform - Add Relax Edge Loops icon and toolshelf entry #6719
why: Relax Edge Loops and Curve Edge Loops Between Selected undocumented in Mesh > Transform and toolshelf.
draft copy: Relax Edge Loops smooths the selected edge loops. Curve Edge Loops Between Selected bends the loops between two selected loops into a smooth curve.
screenshot to take: Mesh Edit Mode > Mesh > Transform menu, plus tool shelf Transform panel

title: Feat: 3D View > Sidebar > View - Expose controls to roll camera view, add roll hotkey #6718 #6858
why: Camera Roll slider in View panel not documented; hotkey already in keymap table.
draft copy: When you look through the camera, the View panel has a Camera Roll slider to tilt the view. Press Backspace over it to reset to 0 degrees. Ctrl+Alt+Middle-mouse drag also rolls the view.
screenshot to take: 3D View camera view > Sidebar > View tab > View panel with Camera Roll

title: Feat: 3D View > Navigation > Gizmo - Add a gizmo to roll the camera view, View Roll in sidebar #6839
why: New roll ring on navigation gizmo and View Roll field; not documented.
draft copy: Drag the thin ring around the navigation gizmo to roll the view. In camera view it rolls the camera when Lock Camera to View is on.
screenshot to take: 3D View navigation gizmo with roll ring highlighted; Sidebar > View with View Roll

title: Fix: 3D View > Weight Paint > Weights - Expose Hide operators to own menu #6758
why: New Show/Hide submenu in Weights menu with selection masking; not on page.
draft copy: With face or vertex selection masking turned on, the Weights menu has a Show/Hide submenu with Show Hidden, Hide Selected and Hide Unselected.
screenshot to take: Weight Paint > Weights menu with face masking on, Show/Hide submenu open

title: 3D View - Armature - Edit Mode - New Duplicate and Rename operator #6576
why: New Duplicate and Rename operator in Armature Edit Mode; not documented.
draft copy: Duplicate and Rename copies the selected bones and asks for a new name right away, so you don't end up with a list of .001 bones.
screenshot to take: Armature Edit Mode > Armature menu with Duplicate and Rename

title: 3D View - Edit Mode - Mesh - Transform - New Flatten operator #6515
why: New Flatten operator in Mesh > Transform; not in Transform section.
draft copy: Flatten moves the selected vertices onto one plane, which is handy for cleaning up faces that should be flat.
screenshot to take: Mesh Edit Mode > Mesh > Transform menu with Flatten

title: 3D View - Mesh - Edit Mode - Transform - New Space Edge Loops Evenly #6575
why: New Space Edge Loops Evenly in Mesh > Transform; not documented.
draft copy: Space Edge Loops Evenly slides the selected edge loops so they sit at equal distances from each other.
screenshot to take: Mesh Edit Mode > Mesh > Transform menu with Space Edge Loops Evenly

title: Asset Browser - Add icons to new operators and organize library and asset menu #6686
why: New Library menu entries, Download Asset, Open File Location; Library menu missing.
draft copy: The Library menu has Refresh Remote Library, Asset Library Paths, and Open or Clear Remote Assets Cache. Select an online asset and choose Download Asset to fetch it, or right-click an asset and choose Open File Location.
screenshot to take: Asset Browser > Library menu open; online asset right-click menu

title: Asset Browser - Add Open Cache and Clear Cache operators for the Online Assets #6688
why: Open/Clear Remote Assets Cache operators added; document with #1286 Library menu.
draft copy: Open Remote Assets Cache shows the folder where downloaded online assets are stored. Clear Remote Assets Cache empties it after asking you to confirm, so you can start fresh.
screenshot to take: Asset Browser > Library menu with cache entries and confirm dialog

title: Week 40 - Asset Browser - Document asset libraries from extensions
why: Extension asset libraries, grouped library dropdown, View Extension undocumented.
draft copy: The library list is grouped into your libraries, project libraries and extension libraries. Right-click an asset from an extension and choose View Extension to see where it comes from.
screenshot to take: Asset Browser library dropdown with the three groups; asset right-click with View Extension

title: Default Asset Library - New Compositor nodes #5867
why: Page is an empty placeholder with wrong (Geometry Nodes) categories; ~99 compositor assets undocumented.
draft copy: The Compositor Library comes with ready-made node groups for the compositor: depth of field, camera shake, patterns and more. Drag one from the Asset Browser into the compositor and adjust its inputs.
screenshot to take: Asset Browser > Default library > Compositor categories with thumbnails; Compositor Add menu > asset categories

title: Default Asset Library - Multiple fixes
why: New Curve to Tube panel and Remesh options in Apply Selected Objects last-operator panel undocumented.

title: Week 40 - Color Management - Document per-project OpenColorIO config
why: Per-project OCIO config and active config display not documented.

screenshot to take: Project settings > Color Management panel, and Render > Color Management > Advanced

title: Default Asset library - New Raycast Node
why: New Raycast node group asset in the Default Library; not listed in the library page.
draft copy: Raycast casts rays from your geometry onto a target and gives you the hit position, normal and distance, ready to plug into your node tree.
screenshot to take: Asset Browser > Default Library > Geometry Nodes catalog showing the Raycast asset

title: Dopesheet - Action Editor Mode - New Duplicate and Replace action #6680
why: New Duplicate and Replace action operator; Replace Action icons updated.
draft copy: Duplicate and Replace Action makes a copy of the current action and assigns it, so you can change the copy without touching the original.
screenshot to take: Dope Sheet > Action Editor > Action menu with Duplicate and Replace

why: Native scene-strip gizmos (retime, move, slip, scrub bars, range toggles) replace addon overlay; docs describe old overlay.

title: Properties Editor - Render - EEVEE - Sampling - Render - Time Limit

why: Essentials updated from Blender 5.3: new hair node, simulation nodes, new compositing thumbnails.

why: Two new GP operators: select layer under cursor, select and isolate; not documented.

screenshot to take: 3D View > Grease Pencil Draw > Select menu with the new layer entries

why: New OpenTimelineIO import/export not documented anywhere.
draft copy: File > Import / Export > OpenTimelineIO (.otio) moves sequencer edits to and from other editing software. Strips, timing and channels carry over.
screenshot to take: File > Import and File > Export menus showing OpenTimelineIO (.otio), plus the export options

title: File Browser - New Current File location
why: New 'Current File' location in the File Browser side panel is not listed.

screenshot to take: File Browser > Tool Shelf > System panel with Current File

title: File Browser - Make a new operator to move to start or end of the fol…
why: New Navigation header menu with To Top/To Bottom and hotkeys; not documented.
draft copy: The Navigation menu in the header holds the folder navigation tools, plus To Top and To Bottom to jump to the start or end of the folder list.
screenshot to take: File Browser > header > Navigation menu open

title: Graph Editor - new Smooth (Gaussian) modifier #6410
why: Smooth (Gaussian) F-Curve modifier missing from the Add F-Curve Modifier table.
